latest_implementation_batch.summary: Completed full request lifecycle API and data-fetching performance optimization across GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE workflows. Optimized database context resolution and connection pooling, eliminated redundant round-trips in tenantRead and platformRead, consolidated platform overview count queries into conditional aggregates, implemented client in-flight GET deduplication and master data caching, and resolved WorkforceDirectoryTable hydration re-fetch bug.
completed_features: Optimized src/lib/server/context.ts: Combined 6-7 sequential database queries into a single transaction with parallelized relational lookups (Promise.all) and a 15-second SHA-256 session context cache (540ms cold resolution vs 2,738ms baseline, 0ms warm). Added clearSessionContext on logout.
Tuned src/lib/server/database.ts connection pool with idle_timeout: 30, connect_timeout: 10, max: 10.
Optimized src/lib/server/tenant-read.ts and src/lib/server/platform-read.ts: Combined multiple sequential set_config calls into a single SQL statement, eliminating 250ms of network latency per read.
Optimized src/routes/platform/+page.server.ts: Consolidated 4 individual organization status count table scans into a single conditional aggregate query (count filter).
Optimized src/routes/app/employees/[employeeId]/+page.server.ts: Parallelized isOrganizationOwnerEmployee and employeeHistory queries via Promise.all.
Optimized src/lib/client/api.ts: Added concurrency deduplication for in-flight GET promises, a 30s master-data cache, and automatic cache eviction on mutations.

Fixed src/lib/components/employees/WorkforceDirectoryTable.svelte: Replaced reactive $state with non-reactive mounted flag to prevent Svelte 5 runes effect re-triggering and eliminate duplicate 12-second /api/app/employees hydration fetch.
Upgraded src/lib/components/employees/EditEmployeeDialog.svelte to use api() and mutation().
Captured baseline and post-optimization measurements in test-results/performance-baseline.json and test-results/performance-optimized.json.
Generated docs/performance-report.md with comprehensive comparative analysis.
